title: Polynomial equality and circuit difference
statement: Let $C$ and $C'$ be arithmetic circuits on the same finite set of inputs, each with a nonempty gate list. The integer-coefficient multivariate polynomials represented by $C$ and $C'$ are equal if and only if the polynomial represented by the circuit formed from them using the specified shifted-node subtraction construction is zero.
